subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this branch become the start of OpenClaw's canonical multi-layer compaction architecture, or should it be split into a smaller pruning/summary fix while multi-pass design stays under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398?
rationale: The answer controls core session-state semantics, public agent-core surface, provider/context-engine ownership, and whether unused multi-pass code should exist before production integration.

options.title: Split and narrow before merge
options.body: Keep only the pieces that preserve existing recent-turn invariants and have real-session proof, leaving the multi-pass architecture to the canonical design thread.

options.title: Sponsor the full architecture
options.body: Accept the broader direction and require the PR to wire one production caller, resolve branch conflicts, and prove fresh-install plus upgrade/session behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers prefer the focused timeout-progress PR and a separate compaction architecture plan over a broad preparatory branch.

recommendation.title: Split and narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Keep only the pieces that preserve existing recent-turn invariants and have real-session proof, leaving the multi-pass architecture to the canonical design thread.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live assignee on this PR and is the clearest current maintainer routing candidate from the available PR state.
